data.title: JPMorgan Asset Sees Bitcoin Beating Stocks, But With a Catch
data.description: JPMorgan Asset Management has included Bitcoin in its long-term capital market assumptions for the first time, forecasting returns that could beat stocks, bonds and gold in a milestone for its Wall Street acceptance.
